name: Caverns of Consumption
summary: Tucked away along the far northern shoreline of Winterspring, the Caverns of Consumption are an isolated coastal cavern hidden beneath the snowy cliffs. Shrouded in cold sea mist, this desolate cave sits far beyond the traveled paths of Kalimdor.

sections.title: The Northern Shore
sections.body: The northern edge of Winterspring drops away into frigid, windswept seas where few travelers ever venture. Carved into the rocky base of the coastal cliffs, the Caverns of Consumption mark one of the most secluded and barren recesses on the continent. Far removed from the goblin outposts and furbolg dens inland, the cave sits quiet against the crashing waves of the North Coast.

faq.q: Where are the Caverns of Consumption?
faq.answer: The caverns are located on the northernmost coastline of Winterspring, tucked into the rocky cliffs where the snowy peaks meet the open ocean.

faq.q: Is anyone living inside the caverns?
aliases: who lives in caverns of consumption
what is inside caverns of consumption
faq.answer: The cave is remote and largely devoid of common inhabitants, sitting isolated on the coast far from the local Winterfall furbolgs and wild beasts of the interior valleys.

faq.q: How do you reach the cavern?
aliases: how to get to caverns of consumption
faq.answer: Reaching the caverns requires journeying to the northern wilderness of Winterspring and finding a way down the sheer coastal cliffs to the water's edge below.
